name: liena
description: Mise en relation entre prestataires et clients — monorepo fullstack

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared-schemas && npm run dev --workspace @liena/api
scripts.tunnel:ngrok:status: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { (Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels).tunnels | ForEach-Object { $_.public_url } } catch { Write-Host 'Aucun agent ngrok sur le port 4040.' }"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared-schemas && npm run build --workspace @liena/mobile && npm run build --workspace @liena/api && npm run build --workspace @liena/admin
scripts.build:netlify-backend: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run build:mobile && npm run build:api
scripts.test: npm run db:validate && npm run test:unit --workspace @liena/api
